provider: Lanzou Premium (蓝奏云优享版, ilanzou)

free_tier.stated: Smaller than legacy Lanzou. The product is the paid successor to the free tier, and the per-file cap is above the legacy 100 MB. No free-quota figure is published

per_object_cap.stated: Above the legacy 100 MB and not published as one number; large-file resolution needs an account

egress.terms: Advertised 不限速, unthrottled, and 下载免登录, download without a login

tooling: the netdisk-fast-download iz parser, which needs authentication only for large files; the OpenList ilanzou driver takes an account and password and has no share mode
chaining: Nothing to multiply, because the capacity is paid. Its role in the topic is as the resolver's iz driver, which is what makes legacy Lanzou links reachable when the direct CDN refuses

limits.value: above 100 MB and unpublished; large-file resolution needs an account

identity_cost.detail: unverified. The marketing page advertises no registration path and the /register and /login routes both bounce to the homepage, so account creation appears app-only. No account was created

reliability_note: The same rotating-CDN problem as legacy Lanzou, plus one observed failure that matters: the resolver issued a direct URL anonymously and the connection then could not be made. A resolved link is not a delivered file

evidence.proved: 302 to https://small5.bakstotre.com/...491744860608972.rar with a filename, so a direct URL was issued anonymously; the connection then failed after 23 seconds
'在线预览, 下载免登录, 不限速, 无损存储'
the driver needs 账户、密码 only
the iz parser needs authentication for large files

binding_note: The capacity is paid and no free figure is published, so the free tier cannot be shown to reach anything. The per-file cap is the number a buyer would need and the page does not publish it.
notes: Recorded because a reader will meet ilanzou as a separate driver in the resolver table and needs to know it is the paid successor and not a second free pan. The one probe is a real finding: a share resolved anonymously and the CDN then refused the TCP connection, which is why the record says a resolved link is not a delivered file.

aliases: Lanzou Premium / 蓝奏云优享版 (ilanzou)
